scope: Declaration inventory comparison only; not an ABI or forward-compatibility verdict

source_compatibility.evidence: Existing declarations are identical. Current compiler builds and network regressions pass. Wildcard import ambiguity has not been independently exercised.

binary_compatibility.limitation: No old precompiled consumer/new library link or ABI layout experiment was executed.

forward_compatibility.limitation: An older library does not provide the newly added APIs. No forward compatibility claim is made.
